name: Farid

prompt.background:
Pakistani family living in the UK, married with two kids. Runs a small pizzeria business; also owns a rental in the UK with modest yield. Already bought an off-plan unit in Ras Al Khaimah and feels they were pushed into it; unsure if it was a good choice. Exploring Dubai and the Middle East as a future home or investment.

Lead source: Facebook ad
Budget: around 2.5M AED
Timeline: up to 24 months; deciding between self-use and investment first
Areas: undecided; wants family-friendly communities with good schools; considering both off-plan and secondary
signature_phrases: Can you send me something on WhatsApp first?
The last agent pushed us into Ras Al Khaimah.
What's the best price you can really do?
prompt.how_they_talk: Warm and chatty, talks about his pizzeria and his kids, but trust is fragile after the Ras Al Khaimah purchase. Brings that up, asks for discounts and talks to many agents.

source: Olga_Personas_and_Roleplays.xlsx (Olga's JSON persona library); age, behaviours, manner, phrases beyond the shared two, pace and voice are drafts to review with Olga.
